{{Quote|Vaylin hunted Senya to the shores of Ord Mantell. She eliminated her mother's knights&mdash;but let Senya live. Is this a sign of familial love? Or a predator toying with her prey? Only time will tell.|[[Jarak]]|<ref name="KOTET 7">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|chapter=7}}</ref>}}
In the aftermath of her defection from the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] during the [[Battle of Odessen]] in [[3630 BBY]], the former [[Knights of Zakuul|Knight of Zakuul]] [[Senya Tirall]] traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] to meet with a group of Knights who opposed her daughter [[Vaylin]]'s rule&mdash;only to find that Vaylin had arrived before her and '''massacred''' the entire group. Vaylin used the slaughter as a trap for her mother, engaging her in a [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|duel]] that only ended when her [[Lightsaber pike/Legends|weapon]] pierced the [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] of a nearby damaged [[Starship/Legends|starship]] and caused a massive explosion. To Tirall's surprise, Vaylin shielded both of them with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], and she was able to escape from her daughter and flee the planet with her critically-injured son, [[Arcann]].<ref name="A Mother's Hope" />
